questions.text: What task is assigned to the angel Hazrat Israfil in Islamic belief?

options.D: Taking souls at the time of death

questions.explanation: Hazrat Israfil (A.S) is the angel assigned the task of blowing the trumpet (Soor) on the Day of Judgment. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, akhirat.

questions.text: How many times will Israfil (علیہ السلام) blow the trumpet?
questions.explanation: Israfil (علیہ السلام) will blow the trumpet two times — the first blow will destroy all creation and the second blow will resurrect everyone. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, akhirat.

questions.text: What is said to be the first meal served in Jannah according to Islamic tradition?
questions.explanation: Note: Sahih al-Bukhari says the first food of the people of Jannah is the extra lobe of fish liver. According to Islamic tradition, the first meal served in Jannah will be Fish Liver. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, akhirat.

questions.text: What path does truthfulness lead to according to Islamic teachings?
questions.explanation: According to Islamic teachings, truthfulness leads to Righteousness (Birr). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, islamic ethics.

questions.text: Which Prophet stated, 'I have been sent to perfect good morals'?
questions.explanation: The Prophet Hazrat Muhammad (PBUH) stated, "I have been sent to perfect good morals." Source: pakjobmcqs.com, islamic ethics.

questions.text: According to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), who is considered the most destitute person in his Ummah?

options.A: A person who has no wealth or property
options.B: A person who neglects the rights of fellow humans
options.C: A person who does not perform Hajj despite having means
options.D: A person who has no children

questions.explanation: According to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), the most destitute person in his Ummah is a person who neglects the rights of fellow humans. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, islamic ethics.

questions.text: What is meant by the term 'Kaazimeen al-Ghaiz' in Islamic teachings?
questions.explanation: The term 'Kaazimeen al-Ghaiz' refers to those who suppress anger. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, islamic ethics.

questions.text: According to Hadith, what is considered a sign of faith (iman) in relation to neighbors?
questions.explanation: According to Hadith, good relations with neighbors is a sign of faith (iman). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, islamic ethics.

questions.text: In what situations are believers allowed to turn their backs in the battlefield?

options.A: When retreating as a stratagem of war
options.B: When joining another detachment of the Muslim army

questions.explanation: Believers are allowed to turn their backs in the battlefield only when retreating as a stratagem of war or to join another detachment of the Muslim army. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, jihad (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: From which language does the term 'Jehad' originate?
questions.explanation: The term 'Jehad' (Jihad) originates from the Arabic language. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, jihad.

questions.text: According to the Hadith, what act, if neither performed nor contemplated, leads a person to die in a state of hypocrisy?
questions.explanation: According to the Hadith, a person who neither performs nor contemplates Jihad dies in a state of hypocrisy. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, jihad.

questions.text: What does the term 'Jihad' literally mean in Islamic context?
questions.explanation: The term 'Jihad' literally means Struggle in the Islamic context. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, jihad.

questions.text: In which year did the first revelation take place?
questions.explanation: The first revelation took place in 610 A.D. when the Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was 40 years old. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prophethood.

questions.text: Who was the Christian cousin of Hazrat Khadijah (Radi Allahu Ta'ala Anha) to whom she told about the first revelation received by Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.)?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Khadijah (R.A) took Prophet Muhammad (S.A.W.) to her Christian cousin Waraqa-bin-Nofal after the first revelation in Cave Hira. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prophethood.

questions.text: Under whose guidance did Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) perform his first prayer?
questions.explanation: Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) performed his first prayer under the guidance of Hazrat Jibreel (AS). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prophethood.

questions.text: Which angel brought the first revelation to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH)?
questions.explanation: The angel who brought the first revelation to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) was Jibreel (Gabriel). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prophethood.

questions.text: Where is the Cave Hira, where Prophet Muhammad (SAW) received his first revelation, located?
questions.explanation: Cave Hira is located on Jabal al-Nour (the Mountain of Light), about 3 km northeast of Makkah. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, prophethood.

questions.text: Who will be the first person to enter Jannah (Paradise) according to Islamic belief?
questions.explanation: The first person to enter Jannah (Paradise) according to Islamic belief is Holy Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, risalat.

questions.text: According to Islamic belief, what is the relationship between a messenger (Rasool) and a prophet (Nabi)?

options.A: Every messenger is a prophet, but not every prophet is a messenger
options.B: Every prophet is a messenger, but not every messenger is a prophet
options.C: Messenger and prophet are completely identical in rank and function
options.D: A messenger is lower in rank than a prophet

questions.explanation: Every messenger (Rasool) is a prophet (Nabi), but not every prophet is a messenger — a Rasool is a Nabi who receives a new divine law (Shariah). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, risalat.

questions.text: What is the primary role of the angel Hazrat Jibra'eel (AS)?

options.A: To provide sustenance and rain to Allah's creation
options.B: To blow the trumpet on the Day of Judgment
options.C: To bring Allah's message and commands to His prophets
options.D: To record the deeds of every human being

questions.explanation: The primary role of Hazrat Jibra'eel (AS) is to bring Allah's message and commands to His prophets. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, risalat.

questions.text: Who is referred to as 'Khatam an-Nabiyyin' (Seal of the Prophets) in Islam?
questions.explanation: The title 'Khatam an-Nabiyyin' (Seal of the Prophets) refers exclusively to Prophet Muhammad (PBUH), signifying that he is the final prophet in Islam. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, risalat.

questions.text: Which prophet of Allah is called Abu Al-Bashar?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Adam (AH) is called Abu Al-Bashar, meaning "Father of Mankind," because he was the first human being created by Allah. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, stories of prophets (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: Who is the mother of Hazrat Yousaf (AS)?
questions.explanation: The mother of Hazrat Yousaf (AS) is Hazrat Raheel. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, stories of prophets (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: Raheel was the wife of which Prophet in Islamic tradition?
questions.explanation: Raheel (Rachel) was the wife of Hazrat Yaqoob (A.S.) and the mother of Hazrat Yusuf (A.S.) and Hazrat Binyamin (A.S.). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, stories of prophets.

questions.text: What is the correct chronological order of the Islamic holy books as they were revealed?
questions.explanation: The correct chronological order of revealed Islamic holy books is Torah → Psalms → Gospel. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, stories of prophets.

questions.text: Who was the first prophet to introduce sciences such as astronomy and writing with a pen?
questions.explanation: The first prophet to introduce sciences such as astronomy and writing with a pen was Hazrat Idrees (AS). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, stories of prophets.

questions.text: Who was the son of Prophet Daud (AS) known for his wisdom and kingdom?
questions.explanation: The son of Prophet Daud (AS) known for his extraordinary wisdom and vast kingdom was Hazrat Suleiman (AS). Source: pakjobmcqs.com, stories of prophets.

questions.text: What did the sons of Hazrat Yaqoob (علیہ السلام) do to Hazrat Yousaf (علیہ السلام)?
questions.explanation: The sons of Hazrat Yaqoob (علیہ السلام) threw Hazrat Yousaf (علیہ السلام) into a well out of jealousy. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, stories of prophets.

questions.text: How many disciples, known as 'Hawariyun', assisted Hazrat Essa (AS) in his mission of preaching?
questions.explanation: Hazrat Essa (AS) was assisted by 12 disciples known as 'Hawariyun' in his mission of preaching. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, stories of prophets.

questions.text: What is the personal name of Allah, the Almighty?
questions.explanation: The personal name of Allah, the Almighty, is Allah, which is His proper and exclusive name not derived from any root word. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, tauheed (marked as a past-paper MCQ).

questions.text: What does the name 'Al-Jaleel' signify among the 99 names of Allah?
questions.explanation: The name 'Al-Jaleel' signifies The Majestic, referring to Allah's attribute of supreme grandeur, dignity, and magnificence. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, tauheed.

questions.text: What is the term used for associating partners with Allah, which is considered the opposite of Tawheed?
questions.explanation: The term for associating partners with Allah, which is the opposite of Tawheed, is Shirk. Source: pakjobmcqs.com, tauheed.
